## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Prague, Czechia. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 4 km. It starts at Madame Tussauds Prague, Celetná 555/6, Staré Město, 110 00 Praha-Praha 1, Czechia. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Madame Tussauds Prague. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Unlock the rich tapestry of Prague's heritage with a ticket already included to Madame Tussauds, setting the stage for a cultural expedition. This tour caters to the avid explorer eager to delve into the architecture, history, and art of Prague while enjoying the freedom of a self-guided audio experience.
> Please note, while admission to Madame Tussauds Prague is provided, an audio tour inside the wax museum is not included, ensuring your attention is fully immersed in the historical wonders that await beyond.
>
> Starting at the lively Madame Tussauds Prague, you are invited to trace an impressive route ending at the historic Prague Castle complex.
>
> The narrative leads you through a procession of landmarks including the historical Old Town Hall with its Astronomical Clock, the iconic Charles Bridge, and the colourful John Lennon Wall. The imposing Prague Castle and serene Kampa Island offer contrasts of majestic and tranquil Prague, while the sights of Wallenstein Palace and Gardens will leave an indelible impression.
>
> While capturing memories among these storied streets and edifices, savor moments such as the hourly spectacle of the Astronomical Clock, or the peaceful charm of Kampa Island's riverside. Your journey concludes with the embrace of Prague Castle, marking a fitting and reflective finale.

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.58. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 132 ratings and 46 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
